detail.longDescription: programming is fun and all of that is fine but how do I compete with a developer with a 200$/500$ Claude subscription? I was fine with making pennies,now I can't even make that. I was fine with competing against thousands of people who claimed competence, I could prove it by making stuff, but now I am just a dot in an ocean that people were wholeheartedly glad to discard and i have no way to get back on the saddle. is there something I'm missing that i should be doing?
